summary: Route-level token/cost breakdown omits prefix/KV cache token contributions causing underreported usage
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that the per-route token and cost breakdown in the Console Usage view is consistently lower than the raw token counts returned by the Usage Export.

Impact: BrightFolio's finance and engineering teams are seeing underreported token usage on route-level dashboards compared to raw exports and the Dedicated billing meter. This is causing inaccurate cost attribution per route and missed alerting thresholds for high-cost routes.

Initial hypothesis: The route-level aggregation is excluding tokens attributed to prefix/KV cache lookups and cached continuation tokens that are consumed by the serving runtime. The raw export (which shows total tokens) includes these cached token events; the Console breakdown appears to sum only direct generation tokens.

Environment: Production, Dedicated pool in us-east-1. Customer uses pinned model redwood-4x-ensemble with KV prefix caching enabled at the route level.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer runs a steady workload against route /api/v1/summarize with prefix caching enabled and sampling that triggers cache hit patterns.
2) Export raw usage via Console -> Usage -> Raw Exports for the 24h window of the test run and compute total tokens per request id.
3) Compare the exported total tokens to the Console Route breakdown (Console -> Usage -> Routes -> /api/v1/summarize) for the same time window.
4) Note that exported totals exceed the Console route-level totals by a consistent percentage (~6-12% in customer's runs).
5) Cross-check Dedicated meter /billing/route-usage which matches raw export rather than console breakdown.
6) Re-run with cache disabled on a small test route and observe that route-level breakdown aligns with raw export when cache is disabled.
logs: Customer provided example request IDs and raw export CSV slice (attached to ticket). Example request id: req_20260310_8f3b2a. Console route view shows 14,120 tokens for window; raw export shows 15,312 tokens for same time span. Dedicated meter matches raw export. No 5xxs observed. Serving runtime request traces show additional 'kv-cache-hit' events that increment internal token counters not surfaced to Console route aggregator.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-11: Support reproduced discrepancy in staging with a small harness that simulates KV prefix hits. When KV hits occur, internal telemetry increments 'cache_served_tokens' metric separate from 'generation_tokens'.

2026-03-12: Console route rollup job (route-usage-aggregator) appears to only consume generation_tokens stream and omits cache_served_tokens stream when computing per-route totals. Rolling-window rollup config references 'route_token_stream=v1' which was deprecated in favor of combined stream 'route_token_stream=v2' in the serving-runtime rollout (PR referenced below).
2026-03-13: Correlation with Dedicated billing meter confirms raw export completeness; mismatch only affects Console route-level UI and derived alerts.

2026-03-14: Engineering confirmed that a config flag flip during serving-runtime rollout introduced a naming inconsistency between emitted metric names and aggregator consumer. Aggregator config is backward-compatible but was not deployed to Console services after the runtime change.
comments: BrightFolio - Anne Ortiz (2026-03-10): We've been seeing route costs lower in the UI vs raw export for two days; our chargeback script depends on Console breakdown. Can you investigate?
Support - Maya Chen (2026-03-11): Thanks Anne — I've reproduced locally with a small harness and escalated to Eng; collecting request ids and raw export CSV. Assigned to eng on triage.
Eng - Eric Patel (2026-03-12): I see the telemetry divergence. Adding related PR and investigating aggregator config. Will attempt a quick fix to include cache_served_tokens in rollup stream.

Eng - Eric Patel (2026-03-13): Root cause found: runtime emission changed metric namespace from 'route.tokens.generated' and 'route.tokens.cache' to a combined 'route.tokens.v2' with sublabels. Console aggregator still listening on old names.
resolution: Workaround: Enabled a temporary aggregator compatibility shim that re-maps 'route.tokens.v2' sublabels to the legacy streams in Console rollup service; this restores route-level parity with raw exports. Long-term fix: Deploy console-aggregator PR that reads the combined v2 stream natively and updates UI labels. Rollout plan scheduled; will coordinate dark-launch across org in us-east then global. Billing and alerting thresholds validated by BrightFolio engineering after shim applied.
next_steps: 1) Merge and deploy console-aggregator PR to production (owner: Eric Patel).
2) Run A/B verification against raw export for 24h window and confirm <1% delta (owner: SRE).
3) Remove compatibility shim after native consumer is live and verified (owner: Eng).
4) Postmortem doc and customer communication drafted (owner: Maya Chen).
